# `/manual-discover-applications` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /manual-discover-applications/v1

`sendManualDiscoverApplicationsCsvTemplateV1` — Upload csv to discover applications

Uploading a CSV file with application data for manual correlation to specific SailPoint Identity Security connectors. If a suitable SailPoint Identity Security connector is unavailable, the system will recommend generic connectors instead.

- Scopes: idn:application-discovery:write
- Body (multipart/form-data): manualdiscoverapplications
- Returns 200: no body
